data.description: Mobile Kia windscreen replacement across Sydney and NSW. We confirm the exact glass your Kia takes, arrange calibration where needed, and quote before the.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a Kia windscreen at my home or work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is how we do most Kia jobs. We bring the glass, the urethane and the tools to the vehicle. We need room to open both front doors and somewhere reasonably sheltered if it is raining.

mainEntity.name: Does my Kia need the camera recalibrated after a new windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost certainly, if it carries Drive Wise. We confirm it from your build when you book and include it in the quote rather than adding it later. See windscreen replacement for how calibration fits into the job.

mainEntity.name: What decides the price of a Kia windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a Kia the single biggest step is whether Drive Wise is fitted, because that adds a calibration to the job as well as narrowing the glass. The build year and grade decide the rest. Our cost guide explains each factor.

mainEntity.name: Can a chip in a Kia windscreen be repaired instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, and on a Kia it is worth asking early: keeping the original glass means the camera behind it never moves, so there is no calibration to arrange either. See windscreen chip repair .
